name: Sword Leveling ⚔️
desc:
⚔️ Welcome to Sword Leveling! ⚔️
Ready to become the ultimate Sword Master?
Every time you level up, you unlock a NEW, more POWERFUL Sword! 💥

🔥 How to Play:
⚔️ Defeat Enemies to earn XP and Level Up!
🗡️ Unlock New Swords every time you level up!
🌍 Explore New Areas and conquer tougher enemies!
🏆 Challenge Your Friends and become the top Sword Master!
🎁 Can you collect EVERY sword and reach the highest level?

If you encounter any bugs please report in the group wall or community server!

👍 Like and Favorite if you enjoy the game!
🏆 +10% XP for every friend in-game!
🏆 Premium players get +10% Damage & Health!
